description: Many producers have no historical record of their fields, so they cannot show they meet sustainability or land-use standards. LoTestigo fixes that with one step: draw your field on a map. Using NASA open data, mainly NISAR radar (which sees through clouds), it builds a logbook of what satellites observed, with every value labelled verified, declared or estimated. It is a proof of concept, not a certification: detection is not yet validated in the field.
